reviews.author: Roporygon
reviews.text: The best restaurant experience in Scotland we had. The vegan options were the best we ever had. Vegan Katsu Curry was 10 / 10. Staff was very friendly. Perfect experience.

reviews.author: Sabiha Shahid
reviews.text: The ramen was really tasty. I had the beef steak ramen and it was spot on. The main problem was the server with pink hair wearing glasses it was me and my husband. The restaurant wasn’t busy either but when I finished my meal she was literally rushing us to get the bill. When we said she can bring the bill on table and asked whether it’s gonna be cash or card we said to give a couple of minutes but she came back 2 times 2 to ask whether we are ready to pay or not which seemed like she was trying to kick us out of the place. People are paying £15 to £20 for having a bowl of ramen but getting this type of horrible service is disgusting.

reviews.author: Adrien Massonnet
reviews.text: (Translated by Google) A mall restaurant where the service is supposed to be very rushed. There were inconsistencies in the service: we received our miso soup and gyoza before our drinks (cocktails), and the dishes arrived at different times (including a sushi/sashimi dish that could have waited). Avoid the gyoza and the miso soup, which were tasteless. The maki, nigiri, and sashimi were quite good. The value for money is rather poor for the basic quality. (Original) Restaurant de centre commercial où le service doit etre très expéditif. Des incohérences dans le service : nous avons eu notre soupe miso et des gyozas avant d avoir nos boissons (cocktails), les plats sont arrivés en décalé (dont un plat de sushi/sashimi qui pouvait attendre avant d etre servi). Evitez les gyozas et la soupe miso qui n ont pas de gouts. Les makis, nigiri, et sashimi etaient plutot bons. Un rapport qualité prix assez mauvais pour la qualité basique.

reviews.author: Traveler
reviews.text: (Translated by Google) Just a heads-up: this restaurant also has another branch called Ramen Ramen. It's the same restaurant, just with a different name! The ramen, may God bless the food, was awful! The side dishes were delicious, and one of the main reasons we chose this place was because they confirmed that the food is halal! However, I wouldn't repeat the experience; the ramen was below average. Just a heads-up: this restaurant also has another branch called Ramen Ramen. As far as I could tell, it's the same restaurant with a different name. The side dishes were actually very tasty, and one of the main reasons we chose this place was because they confirmed that the food is halal. Unfortunately, the ramen itself was very disappointing. It was below average in terms of flavor and didn't live up to expectations at all. I was expecting something much better. Overall, I enjoyed the side dishes more than the main course, but I wouldn't come back for the ramen. It simply wasn't worth repeating the experience. (Original) للتنبيه هذا المطعم يوجد له فرع أخر أسمه رامن رامن ،، نفس المطعم بس اسماء مختلفه !!الرامن الله يعز النعمه ما يسوى !! الاطباق الجانبيه لذيذه ،، ميزته حسب كلامهم انه حلال!! لكن ما اكرر التجربه ، الرامن طعم أقل من عادي. Just a heads-up: this restaurant also has another branch called Ramen Ramen. As far as I could tell, it’s the same restaurant with a different name. The side dishes were actually very tasty, and one of the main reasons we chose this place was because they confirmed that the food is halal. Unfortunately, the ramen itself was very disappointing. It was below average in terms of flavor and didn’t live up to the expectations at all. I was expecting something much better. Overall, I enjoyed the side dishes more than the main course, but I wouldn’t come back for the ramen. It simply wasn’t worth repeating the experience.

reviews.author: Nicole Ratliff
reviews.text: While the food was delicious and came in big portion, the top tier of this place is the staff. I told the staff I had dexterity problems and I needed a fork. They brought me one, but also a really nice male staff member approached me in a very respectful manner asking if he could show me a trick for how to use chopsticks. The trick worked, even with my dexterity problems. Another female staff member who served us was so amazing and the fact ahe asked twice if there were any food allergies at our table, made me feel the restaurant actually cares. Will definitely be back not only for the delicious food, but the beyond amazing customer service these staff members exhibited. That goes a long way.

I am sure I will remember this stunning restaurant and I need to visit it the next time I come to London.

reviews.author: hohojapdiary
reviews.text: * Tonkotsu Ramen ⭐️ * Dynamite Prawns ⭐️ * Tempura Squid ⭐️ * Three Kind Sashimi * Mochi Ice Cream * Yuzu Iced Tea ⭐️ * Mount Fuji ⭐️ * Sparkling Watermelon The tonkotsu ramen was lovely, the noodles texture is just right (not too soggy or too hard); the chasiu was so delicious and the 8 hour broth was amazing 🍜 Dynamite prawns was out of my expectation; it was deep fried in a batter covered with a spicy sauce & yuzu citrus flavour. The combination is surprisingly good 🍤 Tempura squid was deep fried in a thin batter with a generous amount of squid 🦑 it was so tasty however I think it could give us a dipping sauce so it won’t be as dry. The yuzu iced tea was really refreshing with the mint and lemon and there are also yuzu puree bits as well 🍋; the Mount Fuji was also a very refreshing lemonade and it looks so pretty 🗻🩵💙 Also, the service from Navin and Hajoru are amazing! Thank you ☺️

reviews.author: Hanna Mourad-Agha
reviews.text: Absolutely delicious food (vegan black garlic tonkotsu ramen), which arrived very quickly and was clearly freshly made. Quite a few vegan options on the menu, which made me very happy. Ren, Hajar and Mahal were very attentive too (but not overly so)! I will definitely visit again.

reviews.author: Yuchi Yao
reviews.text: Good food, get good service from Navin

reviews.author: Angelina c
reviews.text: This is one of the worst foods I had in London. The karaage chicken did not have a crispy skin as a karaage chicken should but instead tasted like chicken nuggets from McDonald’s and it was way too salty. The ramen had not depth of flavour but salt. The charsiu was inedible due to toughness (seen in picture) caused by either poor reheating or cooking. Could not eat much because of the salt. Not worth your stomach space for this awful establishment. Even bone daddies is better and I think they’re toeing the line of acceptabliy. Do not try your tastebuds here, they will die.

reviews.text: It was a pleasant experience we had in Maki & Ramen Shoreditch. Ren was extremely helpful and always asked if we needed something. We had Tantan ramen and Seafood Hell which were amazing. Also highly recommend Black Dragon Roll with eel tempura!!!

reviews.text: Very good service food was very quick came instantly and was hot - prices are normal nothing to expensive snd for the quality of the food the price shows. The bill came very quick after finsihing and when asked - only thing is it’s pretty hot in certain places of the restaurant so in summer heatwaves choose your seat well.

reviews.text: The ramen is so yummy! My daughter gave it 10/10. Service is fantastic and you should try the prawn tempura 🍤

reviews.author: MadCoaster

reviews.author: Daniel Redknap-Neely
reviews.text: My wife and I visited your location at West Quay tonight for her birthday. Overall we had a good night and enjoyed the food. But there were a couple small things I wanted to mention. On the website it says the restaurant is open until 10pm Monday to Sunday. But we arrived just before 7:30 and were told the kitchen was closing in three minutes and we had to make an order before sitting down if we wanted to eat. This would be fine if it was mentioned on the website as we had driven 40mins to get there and almost missed out. Secondly, we were offered free mochi or a glass of Prosecco for my wife’s birthday (and maybe partially to apologise for the rushed ordering process) but when we got home and checked the bill (the restaurant was closing at 8pm as we left so we didn’t get to check properly there) that were were in fact charged for the (free) mochi.

reviews.author: Jenny Cheng
reviews.text: Maki & Ramen is the best restaurant in Southampton. The ramen and sushi are both amazing. There are plenty of ramen choices, and all the ingredients are fresh and tasty. The restaurant has a great atmosphere, and the staff are always friendly and welcoming. The service is excellent. Highly recommended!

reviews.author: Mao Lee
reviews.text: Good experience, staff are nice, food quality reached expectations

reviews.author: samantha godfrey
reviews.text: Absolutely amazing food and amazing staff 10/10 🩷

reviews.author: Phyllis
reviews.text: The food was great but unfortunately the overall experience was disappointing. We ordered the lunch deal yet we were still overcharged. When checking the bill we were told that the drinks we chose were “premium drinks” with a £2 surcharge each and therefore not included in the lunch deal. Even though the staff member who served us had clearly confirmed that those drinks were not listed as premium on the lunch deal menu. As we were in a rush to leave she offered to remove the service charge, but somehow we still ended up paying the extra drink charges anyway (not sure what’s happened here..) On top of that, we tried to order the chicken karaage and the bone broth ramen but were told that neither was available… which was surprising for a ramen restaurant. Also, when we asked for takeaway containers we were given paper bowls and told that the soup would likely spill if we used them..?

reviews.author: Mo Sin
reviews.text: This place ia awesome. Food was great, presentation was great. Special shout outs to Luca and Jaeda for making the night special for me.

reviews.author: Georgia
reviews.text: I love crispy nori on a hand roll and this place served it up! I came in pre-theatre and had their £49 menu, I probably chose the wrong thing because there was SO much food for 1 person but I don’t regret it. The handrolls were Devine, I could’ve just ordered 5 of them. If you love sushi and love Japanese, give it a go!

reviews.author: Rosana Anunciacao
reviews.text: I genuinely don't understand how this restaurant has such a high rating. We walked past it a few days earlier and decided to give it a try because it had great reviews and looked like a really nice place. Unfortunately, it turned out to be a huge disappointment. The service was embarrassingly poor and completely below the standard the restaurant claims to offer. The place itself looked dirty and gave the impression of very poor hygiene. The most shocking part was the sushi. It was absolutely awful—worse than cheap supermarket sushi. It certainly didn't taste fresh and definitely didn't seem like it had been made that day. The only decent thing we had was the fried chicken, which was actually quite good. Sadly, that wasn't enough to make up for the rest of the experience. After leaving my review, I did a quick Google search and discovered that the restaurant only opened on 10 April 2026. What I found even more surprising was that it already had over 400 reviews, the vast majority of them positive. Given the quality of our experience, I genuinely struggle to understand how that is possible. While I can't say why this is the case, the numbers simply don't seem to add up from my perspective. Overall, it was a complete disappointment from beginning to end, and I certainly wouldn't recommend it.

reviews.author: chelsea “itsChelsea” marie
reviews.text: Delicious food and lovely ambience. Luca was super accommodating. Thank you!

reviews.author: Jason Li
reviews.text: I had an amazing sushi experience tonight. The price was very reasonably priced with this central location. Staff were friendly and helpful, recommended some special dishes. Sushi chef created my sushi and Sashimi plate on the boat👍👍👍。Like A5 Wagyu beef hand rolls❤️❤️❤️. Spicy tempura prawns are delicious. Homemade plum wine and yuzu ice tea are fantastic. We would definitely recommend this place to my colleagues & friends, and definitely we will be back again soon. 👏👏👏

reviews.author: Daniel Z
reviews.text: Excellent Japanese restaurant! The 15-course sushi and sashimi set was outstanding—fresh, delicious, and great value for money. The plum wine was also highly recommended. Everything was beautifully presented with great service. I’ll definitely be back!
